label: honne_rejection
text:
Honne is our iPhone app that reads a text message and tells you what the other person probably meant.

Apple rejected the update this morning: "the in-app purchase is not available."

The cause was one setting. The paywall was pointing at the plan list of a different app of ours, https://t.co/VgRJhrMLGL
note: actuals are the x_presim backtest values from team/metrics/presim-log.csv, not a later metrics snapshot

label: store_funnel
text:
We make an iOS affirmation app called Anicca. Last week I pulled every number from the App Store search result to the payment screen.

334 people saw it in search.
14 opened the page.
1 downloaded it.
0 paid.

Worse, our analytics never saw that one person. Every "new user" in https://t.co/QkMgNtsQUu

text:
SFのYC本社で開かれた、AIエージェントに会社を経営させる「自律型カンパニー」ハッカソンに現地参加してきました。

優勝は、3Dプリンターで実物を作って売ったチーム。13体のエージェントで挑んだ私たちは入賞なしです。 https://t.co/r2KPMbg6tc
